name: Stone Titan
descr: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerful items inlaid with magical runes.

data.motivesAndTactics: Blend into the rocks, craft and contemplate, pursue prophecy and solitude

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Skillful Strike
features.text: Before the Titan makes an attack, you can **mark a Stress** and roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Sunlight Sickness
features.text: When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a **d4**. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Hammer Smash
features.text: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).
